faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIELIT IT Resource Persons posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the IT Resource Persons posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in relevant fields, MCA, or a B.Sc (Computer Science Engg. – 4 Year degree course) from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for NIELIT recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 750/- for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the IT Resource Persons posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,519/- to Rs. 2,59,364/- per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the NIELIT IT Resource Persons recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official NIELIT website or the provided application link before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is 07/348/2026/NDL/FM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct download link for the official notification PDF is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
